## Tidying

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library("here")
dat_load <- read_tsv(file = here("data/01_dat_load.tsv"),
                     show_col_types = FALSE)
sfari_load <- read_tsv(file = here("data/01_sfari_load.tsv"),
                       show_col_types = FALSE)
hippocampus_expression_matrix <- read_tsv(here("data/01_hippocampus_load.tsv"),
                                          show_col_types = FALSE)
DLPFC_expression_matrix <- read_tsv(here("data/01_dlpfc_load.tsv"),
                                    show_col_types = FALSE)
```



```{r}
# Calling the first row of the two expression matrices, as tibbles, which are both transformed to extract their linearized values as pure vectors, which are converted to pcw, unless they're already born whereupon their unit is converted to years (yrs).

ltnc <- "(?<=plus0\\.7_)-?\\d+\\.\\d+"
hpc_colnames <- tibble(sample=names(hippocampus_expression_matrix))|> mutate(age_log = as.numeric(str_extract(sample, ltnc))) |> filter(!is.na(age_log)) |> mutate(age = round(((10^age_log-0.7)*52+40),1)) |> mutate(age = if_else(age >= 40, str_c(round((age-40)/52,1),"yrs"),str_c(age,"pcw"))) 

dlpfc_colnames <- tibble(sample=names(DLPFC_expression_matrix))|> mutate(age_log = as.numeric(str_extract(sample, ltnc))) |> filter(!is.na(age_log)) |> mutate(age = round(((10^age_log-0.7)*52+40),1)) |> mutate(age = if_else(age >= 40, str_c(round((age-40)/52,1),"yrs"),str_c(age,"pcw"))) 

# Converting the legible value tables to lists.

hpc_list <- as.list(hpc_colnames) 
dlpfc_list <- as.list(dlpfc_colnames)

# Replacing the linearized, logarithmic column values with standardized cwd/yr values.
hpc_exp_matrix_revised_colnames <- hippocampus_expression_matrix
colnames(hpc_exp_matrix_revised_colnames) <- c("gene", make.unique(as.character(hpc_list$age)))

dlpfc_exp_matrix_revised_colnames <- DLPFC_expression_matrix
colnames(dlpfc_exp_matrix_revised_colnames) <- c("gene", make.unique(as.character(dlpfc_list$age)))

dlpfc_exp_matrix_revised_colnames

```

```{r}
tidy_matrix1 <- dat_load |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("ENSG"),
               names_to = "gene",
               values_to = "rpkm") |>
  separate_wider_delim(cols = gene,
                       delim = "_",
                       names = c("ensembl_gene_id", "gene_symbol"),
                       too_few = "align_start",
                       too_many = "merge") |>
  select(ensembl_gene_id, gene_symbol, donor_id, gender, age,
         structure_name, rpkm)

```

```{r}
sfari <- sfari_load |>
  rename_with(\(x) str_replace_all(x, "-", "_")) |>
  rename_with(\(x) str_replace_all(x, "-", "_")) |>
  select(ensembl_id, gene_score, syndromic) |>
  filter(!is.na(ensembl_id)) |>
  distinct(ensembl_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

tidy_matrix1 <- tidy_matrix1 |>
  left_join(sfari,
            by = join_by(ensembl_gene_id == ensembl_id),
            relationship = "many-to-one")

sfari |>
  anti_join(tidy_matrix1 |> distinct(ensembl_gene_id),
            by = join_by(ensembl_id == ensembl_gene_id))

sfari_matrix <- tidy_matrix1 |>
  filter(gene_score >= 1 | syndromic == 1) |> select(ensembl_gene_id,gene_symbol,donor_id,gender,age, structure_name,rpkm,gene_score,syndromic)

tidy_matrix1
```
